definitions.explanation: A commissioned officer in the military — someone holding the rank of second lieutenant or above, who commands enlisted personnel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{陸軍|りくぐん}→陸軍：19089_rikugun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{将校|しょうこう}だった。
{将校|しょうこう}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}っている→練る：09751_neru⟧。
examples.english: The officers are working out a strategy.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{将校|しょうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いて→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: A young officer led the unit toward the front line.

notes:
Refers to commissioned officers (second lieutenant and above). A formal, somewhat historical military term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{陸軍|りくぐん}→陸軍：19089_rikugun⟧{将校|しょうこう}: army officer
- {若|わか}い{将校|しょうこう}: a young officer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {士官|しかん}: officer — a near-synonym, also used for naval officers
- ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧: soldier; enlisted man — the ranks that officers command
